name: 113 會考模擬二模（翰林 1～4 冊）英語聽力（附聽力稿）
source: 翰林 113 學年度國中教育會考模擬測驗（範圍 1～4 冊），答案與解析取自官方試題分析

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
There is no fruit in the basket. Only a watermelon is next to it.
請選出符合描述的圖片。
questions.e: 中譯：籃子裡沒有水果，只有一個西瓜在籃子旁邊，選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
Nancy felt terrible after she saw a ghost movie.
請選出符合描述的圖片。
questions.e: 中譯：Nancy 看完鬼片之後覺得很不舒服，選(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
All the cars stopped to wait for an old man to cross the road.
請選出符合描述的圖片。
questions.e: 中譯：所有的車都停下來等一位老先生過馬路，選(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
My father is a writer. How about yours?
o: He works in a shoe factory.
questions.e: 中譯：我的爸爸是作家。你的呢？回答爸爸的職業最合適，選(B)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
How long can I use the computer?
o: You can use it once a week.
I bought the computer two months ago.
Thirty minutes. Some people are still waiting.
questions.e: 中譯：我可以使用電腦多久？回答使用時間最合適，選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
The pink dress looks great on you. How much did you spend on it?
questions.e: 中譯：這件粉紅洋裝穿在妳身上真好看。妳花多少錢買的呢？回答價錢最合適，選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
I saw Miss Holt talk to Jake angrily just now.
o: What did he do this time?
questions.e: 中譯：我剛剛看到 Miss Holt 很生氣地跟 Jake 講話。最合適的回應為「他這次又做了什麼？」，選(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
Lisa, we are going to Betty’s birthday party. Do you want to join us?
o: Sure. I can’t wait to give Betty a surprise!
No worries. The birthday cake tasted delicious.
questions.e: 中譯：Lisa，我們正要去 Betty 的生日派對。妳要加入我們嗎？最合適的回應為「當然。我等不及要給 Betty 驚喜了！」，選(B)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
Mike Lee is my favorite singer. His songs always make me happy.
o: Be happy. You can sing, too.
Me too. I love his songs.
questions.e: 中譯：Mike Lee 是我最喜愛的歌手。他的歌曲總是讓我開心。最合適的回應為「我也是。我愛他的歌。」，選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
Look! The cloud in the sky looks like a bear.
questions.e: 中譯：你看！那朵天上的雲看起來像一隻熊。最合適的回應為「對啊，好可愛。」，選(B)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿）選出最適合的回應：
Is there anything wrong in the kitchen? I smell something terrible from it.
o: That’s right. Mom is good at cooking.
questions.e: 中譯：廚房是否有不對勁的地方呢？我聞到某個來自廚房的可怕味道。最合適的回應為「對，我把雞肉燒焦了。」，選(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
M: Hey, Amy. What are you doing?
W: I am reading a book about baking. I borrowed it from the library.
M: Why?
W: I want to make my cake taste as yummy as the ones in the bakery on the corner.
M: Wow, it’s not that easy. May I have the pleasure to taste your delicious cake?
W: No problem. I am going to bake a chocolate cake this afternoon. Come to my place and you can help me with it.
M: Sure. I can’t wait! See you then.
W: See you.
Q: Where is the man going this afternoon?
questions.e: 由對話內容女人提問「我今天下午要烤巧克力蛋糕。來我家幫忙吧。」及男子回答「當然。我迫不及待了…」可推知男子下午會前往 Amy 家，故選(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
G: Jason, come here! I know the answer.
B: Let me see. Oh, your answer is wrong.
G: What? It’s not possible.
B: You should do this... and that... See? My answer is right.
G: No, you are wrong. You miss this part. It is very important!
B: It is NOT!
G: Come on! It’s no use fighting here. Let’s go ask Mr. Wang.
B: Fine! I’m pretty sure he will say my answer is right!
Q: What are they going to do next?
o: Check the answer with the teacher.
questions.e: 兩人在爭論誰的答案才是對的，最後女孩說在這邊吵沒用，提議要去問 Mr. Wang，男孩答應並很確定老師會說他的答案是對的，故可推知兩人要去找老師對答案，選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
M: What are you holding in your hand, Alice?
W: Two bottles of milk tea.
M: That’s strange. You always say “No” to drinks.
W: Don’t worry. The milk tea is sugar free. By the way, some drinks at Rosa’s Milk Tea Shop are on sale.
M: Oh, I see.
W: Here. One bottle is for me. The other is for you.
M: Really? That’s great. I love milk tea. Thanks a lot.
W: You are welcome.
Q: How did the man feel when the woman got him a bottle of milk tea?
questions.e: 由對話內容男子提到「太棒了。我愛奶茶。」可推知男子的情緒，故選(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
M: Why didn’t she write a letter back to me? Why not?
W: Who didn’t write a letter back to you?
M: Tina. Last week, I sent her a Teddy Bear with a card. In the card, I told her how much I like her, and I hope she can write back to me by this Sunday.
W: Oh, come on. Sunday is still three days away. Give her some time, OK? By the way, I guess she likes you, too.
M: Really? Why?
W: Yes. To be honest, Tina wanted me to go pick up a card with her yesterday. I think the card is for you.
M: You think so?
W: Yes. Let’s just wait and see.
Q: What is the man worried about?
o: Tina may not like the Teddy Bear.
Tina and the woman won’t be friends.
questions.e: 男子提到「在卡片裡，我跟她說我有多麼喜歡她，而且我希望她可以在週日之前回我信。」但 Tina 遲遲沒有回信，可推知男子擔心 Tina 可能拒絕他的愛意，故選(B)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
W: I am so excited. My favorite writer, Andy Wu, is coming to Taiwan.
M: Really? One of his books, Wonderland, is popular with teenagers.
W: Yeah. I love it, too. He is going to meet his fans in Taipei.
M: Wow, I can’t wait to see him. Maybe we can go together.
W: Sure. But first... we have to get the tickets.
M: How can we get the tickets?
W: That’s easy. We have to buy his latest book, Happy Island. Each book comes with a free ticket.
M: Then let’s go to the bookstore now.
W: Let’s go.
Q: Why are the man and the woman going to buy Happy Island?
o: It is popular with teenagers in Taiwan.
They want to get the tickets to meet the writer.
They like the book by Andy Wu very much.
questions.e: 由對話內容女子提到「我們必須買他最新的書，Happy Island。每本書都附有一張免費的門票。」及男子回應「那麼我們現在就去書店吧。」可推知，故選(B)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
（人群喧鬧聲）
W: Well, how do you like this night market?
M: It is not big but has everything! Nice food, cold drinks, clothes and game stands. Everything!
W: That’s true. It is one of my favorite night markets.
M: Actually, I was today years old when I learned I was wrong about night markets in Taiwan.
W: Really? You never tried visiting any one before? But you have been in Taiwan for two years.
M: I thought there was nothing special about night markets. But now I know it is fun to visit night markets.
W: Haha, I’m glad you like it.
Q: When the man says “I was today years old when I learned I was wrong about night markets in Taiwan,” what does he mean?
o: He always enjoys the food at the night market.
He will buy a lot of things at the night market.
He never knew it is fun to visit a night market in Taiwan.
questions.e: 從對話前後語意得知男子對臺灣夜市看法改觀，推知選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
B: Did you see John’s cellphone?
G: Yes. I saw that after school yesterday. It is the latest cellphone and it’s very expensive.
B: That’s right. It’s not cheap for both of us, but forty thousand NT dollars is just a piece of cake for John.
G: I agree. Do you know that? John’s mother gives him four thousand NT dollars as his pocket money every week.
B: Oh my! That’s ten times my pocket money! For John about money: easy come, easy go.
G: That’s true. I think I need a rich mother like John’s.
Q: What does the boy think about John?
o: John likes his mother very much.
John has a lot of pocket money.
John doesn’t like his old cellphone.
questions.e: 由「天啊！這是我零用錢的十倍！」可推知，故選(B)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
M: Today is Saturday. Mr. and Mrs. Lin don’t have to go to work. Their son and daughter are at home, too. Mr. Lin and his son, Jimmy, are washing the car in the yard. Mrs. Lin is watering the flowers in the garden. Jimmy’s younger sister, Tina, is drawing pictures in the living room. Later, they will go to the restaurant for lunch and see a movie in the afternoon.
Q: Who is inside the house?
questions.e: 由聽力內容得知，Jimmy 的妹妹 Tina 正在客廳畫圖，因此可推論答案為(A)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
（廣播聲）
M: Good morning, everyone. Today is Joy Department Store’s 10th birthday. If you have our Joy Card, check your card number. If it has the number one or zero, show your Joy Card and you can get a free ice cream at Linda’s Kitchen on the third floor. More luckily, if the last two numbers are one and zero, you can enjoy a free meal at John’s Steakhouse on the fifth floor. To celebrate Joy Department Store’s birthday, we prepare 100 Teddy Bears. Go to the top floor with your kid and say “Happy birthday to Joy Department Store,” and your kid can get a Teddy Bear for free.
Q: If your Joy Card number is 24610, what can you get from Joy Department Store at most?
questions.e: 對話內容提到「更幸運地是如果你的號碼末兩碼是 1 和 0，你可以在五樓的 John 牛排館享用免費的一餐。」可推知，故選(C)。

questions.q:
（聽力稿，原題播放兩次）
W: OK, are you ready? Please stand in front of that wall. Hey, take it easy. Give me a smile. Good! Now please touch your right shoulder with your right hand and stand like this. And look that way. Oh, don’t forget your smile. Great! You are like a superstar. Now please come here. All your photos are on the computer. Please choose your favorite one.
Q: What are they doing?
questions.e: 由女子教人如何擺動作且微笑，還請對方過來挑最喜歡的照片，可知女子是在幫人拍照，故選(B)。
